title: LibScript Tier 3.5 Cluster Topology Specification
description: Declarative schema defining multi-node cluster topologies, quorum choreography, split-brain fencing policies, encrypted mesh overlays, and node groups.

name.description: Unique identifier for the cluster topology deployment

version.description: Semantic version string of the topology blueprint

description.description: Human-readable description of the cluster topology and architecture

quorum_strategy.description: Distributed consensus and quorum formation strategy used by the cluster

fencing_policy.description: Split-brain fencing mechanism invoked before promoting a follower to leader

node_groups.description: List of homogeneous node pools participating in the cluster topology

items.description: Specification for a group of cluster nodes sharing a role and hardware profile

name.description: Identifier for this node group pool (e.g. primary, replicas, workers)

provider.description: Tier 3 cloud or hypervisor infrastructure provider

region.description: Cloud region or availability zone placement identifier

size.description: Machine instance type or sizing profile (e.g. Standard_D4s_v3, t3.xlarge, e2-standard-4)

count.description: Number of nodes to provision in this node group

role.description: Consensus and operational role assigned to nodes in this group

components.description: Tier 1 _lib components installed and managed on nodes in this group

traits.description: Node-level substrate traits enabled on nodes in this group

items.description: Trait identifier (e.g. storage, secrets, mesh, firewall, discovery, tls, ingress, backup)

disks.description: Persistent block storage volumes attached to each node in the group

mount_point.description: Target directory mount path on the host

accelerators.description: Optional GPU or TPU hardware accelerators attached to nodes in this group

gpu_type.description: GPU hardware model identifier (e.g. nvidia-tesla-a100, nvidia-h100-80gb)

gpu_count.description: Number of GPU devices per node

tpu_accelerator_type.description: Google Cloud TPU accelerator configuration (e.g. v4-8, v5litepod-16, v5p-128)

tpu_slice_count.description: Number of multi-host TPU slices in the node pool

network.description: Cluster network addressing, encrypted overlay mesh, and DNS zone settings

vpc_cidr.description: IPv4 CIDR block allocated for the private cluster network (e.g. 10.42.0.0/16)

dns_zone.description: Public Cloud DNS zone name for external service discovery records

internal_domain.description: Private internal domain suffix mapped via /etc/hosts and service discovery (e.g. cluster.internal)

choreography.description: Ordered lifecycle choreography hooks executed across the cluster state machine

pre_provision.description: Commands or hooks executed before cloud infrastructure provisioning begins

substrate_prep.description: Traits and setup actions executed on all nodes prior to service bootstrapping

leader_bootstrap.description: Hooks executed on the designated leader node to initialize cluster quorum

follower_join.description: Hooks executed on follower and worker nodes to join the active leader quorum

post_cluster.description: Verification and ingress routing actions executed after cluster quorum is healthy

pre_drain.description: Graceful connection draining and replication sync steps run before node removal

post_destroy.description: Cleanup, final state backup, and DNS unmapping actions run during teardown
